name: Tempered mail hauberk
description: Rings drawn tighter and hardened by a smith with something to prove. Heavy, but so is a bad day.
notes: Fine medium body armor, the tempered cousin of the mail hauberk at the same weight. Weight 8 kg (ADR-0003 reference weights). Catalogue tier fine (economy doc, body armor medium 180-300 x2.5). Authored for shop stock (mw-ju8.3); not for sale until a shop row stocks it (mw-ju8.5).
